overall: Strong final draft: all 78 pool tokens are covered, the checker passes 230/230, and every fact I checked is correct with a single right answer. The exclusive calls (anair, Bord, Donegal, Dublin x2, Ireland, riscoll, Ryanair, Sinn, Valera) are sound. Ulster should also have been exclusive. The 10 drops fall into two groups. Three items are not neutral because they are about Northern Ireland and island-of-Ireland politics or geography (Belfast as capital of Northern Ireland, the Ulster Unionist item, the NI item about Northern Ireland). The rest have a purely decorative token: a parenthetical abbreviation after the spelled-out name ((NI), (IRA)), the phrase "often called the IRA", or an 'according to Guinness World Records' citation. Those questions answer the same with the token removed. After the drops, NI, the no-space IRA, inness and Ulster have no items left, and the other thin multi tokens (Clon, Dunne, Dá, Kildare, Ó, Fá, Fé, Pá, Conor, Galway, Redmond) keep their 1-3 items as justified in the notes.
